prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select the companion personality that best fits your daily workspace workflow.", "Companion Selection"]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Quick controls: Right-click pet to open menu, drag to move around desktop, press Ctrl+Space to chat.", "You can change these shortcuts anytime in app settings.", "Start Desktop Session", "Right-click for options | Drag to re-position | Ctrl+Space to talk"]
2: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "We are preparing your pet graphics and desktop animation engine.", "Check out desktop hotkeys while your pet generates.", "Did you know? Double-clicking your pet makes it do a special trick on your taskbar!"]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop companion an official name to finalize ownership.", "Sign & Adopt"]
4: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Workspace", "Choose how you want your desktop companion to assist your daily routine.", "Explore Companions"]
5: ["Upload Clear Front-Facing Photos", "For best generation results, use well-lit photos with clear contrast and simple backgrounds.", "Avoid blurry images or photos with multiple subjects for optimal quality.", "Upload Photo"]
6: ["Sign In to Sync Your Pets", "Log in with your existing account to instantly restore your pets, custom items, and desktop progress.", "Be sure to use the same email you used during original setup.", "Sign In with Account", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled"]
7: ["Your desktop companion will automatically pop up in your taskbar and desktop once rendering finishes."]
8: ["Setup Complete!", "Your companion is ready on your desktop screen.", "View Pet Controls"]
9: ["Signing in anchors your pets to your account so progress is never lost when reinstalling."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos of the user
